<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rajasthan municipal polls:</strong> The BJP has secured significant leads across multiple municipal bodies, including Bhilwara, Ajmer, and Jaipur, while Congress maintains pockets of support in areas like Jodhpur.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Uniform Civil Code:</strong> Home Minister Amit Shah has confirmed that all 21 NDA-governed states are set to implement a Uniform Civil Code before 2029.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Transgender rights:</strong> Parliament has officially passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, following approval from the Rajya Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Women’s reservation:</strong> A Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lower House.</li>
  <li><strong>Judicial appointments:</strong> The Supreme Court faces ongoing scrutiny regarding the diversity of its bench as it considers a plea for a National Judicial Pay Commission.</li>
</ul>
